title: Cherry Blossom Trails of Japan | Group Tour Package
highlights: Wander through Japan’s stunning cherry blossom trails, where ancient temples, scenic landscapes, and futuristic skylines create an unforgettable journey.
Step into the world of Tokyo TeamLab Planets, an immersive digital art museum where interactive installations, flowing water, and mirrored surfaces create a surreal experience.
Experience the magic of Nabana no Sato, where stunning seasonal flowers and dazzling winter illuminations transform the landscape into a stunning wonderland.
Marvel at the futuristic architecture of the Umeda Sky Building, a striking twin tower skyscraper offering stunning views of Osaka from its floating observatory.
Explore the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum, a powerful tribute to history and resilience, featuring artifacts and the impact of the 1945 atomic bombing.
inclusions: Transfer from Kansai International Airport to Super Deluxe Hotel
4 nights stay in Osaka with breakfast
Todai-ji Temple & Nara Deer Park Day Tour
1 night stay in Nagoya with breakfast
Hakone Ropeway Cable Car Tickets, Japan
3 nights stay in Tokyo with breakfast
Transfer from Super Deluxe Hotel to Narita International Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
Any extra excursions or sightseeing apart from the above specified itinerary.
know_before_you_go: You should carry your passport and visa at the time of arrival.
Images are used for representation purposes only.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
Meals in restaurants or cafes are not included.
Travel insurance is not included in the package.
Many attractions, including temples and shrines, require you to remove shoes, so wear easy-to-slip-off footwear.
Get a SIM card or a pocket WiFi device for seamless internet access, as public WiFi can be unreliable.
Avoid speaking loudly on trains and buses, and always stand on the correct side of the escalator (left in Tokyo, right in Osaka).
Japan’s emergency number is 110 for police and 119 for fire/ambulance—learn a few basic Japanese phrases in case of emergencies.
Any activities or transfers not specified in the itinerary are not part of the package and require separate arrangements.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travellers will be accommodated in a property of a similar standard.
Take permissions before photographing any locals.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to the Land of Rising Sun, Japan! Upon arrival at the Kansai Airport, get driven to your hotel. Post check-in, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can visit the Osaka Museum of Housing & Living, housing life-sized recreations of Edo-period streets & homes, offering a rare chance to step into a bygone era. Next, you can dive into the neon-lit wonderland of Den Den Town or visit Sumiyoshi Taisha, one of Japan’s oldest shrines.

days.title: Bullet Train Ride to Hiroshima | Hiroshima and Miyajima Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven to Shin-Osaka station for a Shinkansen ride to Hiroshima, experiencing Japan’s legendary bullet train ride. Upon arrival, you'll be taken to visit Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park, a poignant tribute to the victims of the atomic bombing. Next, witness the Atomic Bomb Dome, a powerful symbol of survival, & continue to the Itsukushima Shrine, where the iconic Torii gate appears to float on the sea. Later, return to Osaka via bullet train and from there, get driven to your hotel.

days.title: Osaka Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Begin your day by exploring Osaka on a sightseeing tour. Start with a visit to the iconic Osaka Castle, a symbol of Japan’s feudal past and home to exhibits of Samurai history. Next, stroll through the Nishinomaru Garden and admire the stunning cherry blossoms. Then, ascend the Umeda Sky Building, an architectural marvel & soak in the amazing views from its observation deck. Later, dive into the neon-lit wonder of Dotonbori Street, the heart of Osaka’s nightlife, & soak in its vibrant energy.

days.title: Day Trip to Kyoto
days.desc: Today, get driven to explore Kyoto & visit Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, where towering green stalks create an otherworldly ambience. Next, marvel at the stunning architecture of Kinkakuji Temple, Kyoto’s iconic Golden Pavilion and stroll through the Philosopher’s Path, a stone walkway lined with cherry trees. Then, ascend to Kiyomizudera Temple, renowned for its vast wooden terrace and enjoy stunning views of Kyoto. Later, visit the Fushimi Inari Shrine, home to Kyoto’s famous vermilion torii gates.

days.title: Transfer to Nagoya | Visit to Nara Deer Park & Nabana no Sato
days.desc: After checking out of your hotel, get driven to Nagoya. En route, explore Nara and visit Todaiji Temple, home to the Great Buddha—one of Japan’s largest bronze statues. Then, explore Nara Deer Park and get a chance to feed the deer roaming freely in the park. Next, embark on a journey to Nagoya, & en route, make a stop at Nabana no Sato, a floral wonderland famed for its spectacular LED illuminations & vibrant gardens. Later, continue to Nagoya & upon arrival, check in to your hotel.

items.title: Todai-ji Temple & Nara Deer Park Day Tour

days.title: Transfer to Tokyo | Hakone Ropeway Ride | Lake Ashi Cruise Experience | Visit to Mt. Fuji's 5th Station
days.desc: Post check out, get driven to Tokyo. En route, make a stop at Sōunzan Station and embark on the Hakone Cable Car ride, soaring over steaming volcanic vents formed by an ancient eruption. Next, get driven to Hakone Port and board the Lake Ashi Cruise, offering stunning views of Mt. Fuji. Also, visit Mt. Fuji’s 5th Station, the highest accessible point by vehicle and soak in the views of Fuji's Five Lakes below. Continue to Tokyo and upon arrival, check in to your hotel.

items.title: Hakone Ropeway Cable Car Tickets, Japan

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, explore Tokyo on a sightseeing tour and visit Ueno Park, home to vibrant cherry blossoms. Next, step into history at Asakusa Temple (Senso-ji), Tokyo’s oldest Buddhist temple. Then, wander through Nakamise Street, a lively shopping avenue filled with stalls of handmade crafts, & visit Tokyo’s futuristic waterfront district, Odaiba. Also, marvel at the stunning Statue of Liberty replica and explore Tokyo TeamLab Planets, a digital art museum showcasing fascinating exhibits.

days.title: Leisure Day in Tokyo
days.desc: Today, spend your day at leisure, where you can explore Tokyo on your own. You can visit the Imperial Palace, the residence of Japan’s Emperor and marvel at its stunning architecture. Also, you can visit the Tokyo Tower, an iconic red-and-white landmark offering panoramic views of the city skyline. For more thrills, you can enter a world of wonder at Tokyo Disneyland and create unforgettable memories with your beloved Disney characters. Also, explore various theme parks and ride amazing rides.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check out from your hotel in Tokyo. Then, board your transfer and get driven to the airport for your flight back home, marking the end of your amazing Japan trip.
